uppercaseInitialism.text: Identifier "{{name}}" spells an initialism in capitals. Use "{{suggestedName}}": the house writes an initialism the way it writes any other word in a name, capitalized at its first letter only, as in Url, Id, Json and Http. A run of capitals hides where one word ends and the next begins, and a name spelled one way here and another way there is two names for the next reader to search for.
